heading: Development of technologies and in-space capabilities for beyond near-Earth space missions

tree.heading: Development authorized
tree.text: The Administrator may initiate activities to develop the following:

children.text: Technologies identified as necessary elements of missions beyond low-Earth orbit.

In-space capabilities such as refueling and storage technology, orbital transfer stages, innovative in-space propulsion technology, communications, and data management that facilitate a broad range of users (including military and commercial) and applications defining the architecture and design of such missions.
Spacesuit development and associated life support technology.

tree.heading: Investments
tree.text: In developing technologies and capabilities under subsection (a), the Administrator may make investments—

children.text: in space technologies such as advanced propulsion, propellant depots, in situ resource utilization, and robotic payloads or capabilities that enable human missions beyond low-Earth orbit ultimately leading to Mars;
in a space-based transfer vehicle including these technologies with an ability to conduct space-based operations that provide capabilities—
to integrate with the Space Launch System and other space-based systems;
to provide opportunities for in-space servicing of and delivery to multiple space-based platforms; and
to facilitate international efforts to expand human presence to deep space destinations;
in advanced life support technologies and capabilities;
in technologies and capabilities relating to in-space power, propulsion, and energy systems;
in technologies and capabilities relating to in-space propellant transfer and storage;
in technologies and capabilities relating to in situ resource utilization; and
in expanded research to understand the greatest biological impediments to human deep space missions, especially the radiation challenge.

tree.heading: Utilization of ISS as testbed
tree.text: The Administrator may utilize the ISS as a testbed for any technology or capability developed under subsection (a) in a manner consistent with the provisions of this chapter.

tree.heading: Coordination
tree.text: The Administrator shall coordinate development of technologies and capabilities under this section through an overall agency technology approach, as authorized by section 905 of this Act.

notes.text: References in TextSection 905 of this Act, referred to in subsec. (d), is Pub. L. 111–267, title IX, § 905, Oct. 11, 2010, 124 Stat. 2836, which is not classified to the Code.
